program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-vals (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                       (map (lambda (c) (at g r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                     (range 0 h)))
                  (nz-vals (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) all-vals))
                  (colors (unique nz-vals))
                  (minority (find (lambda (color)
                                    (= 1 (for/sum ((v nz-vals)) (if (= v color) 1 0))))
                                  colors))
                  (mc (first (find-color g minority)))
                  (mr (fst mc))
                  (mcc (snd mc))
                  (open-dir (cond
                              ((and (> mr 0) (zero? (at g (- mr 1) mcc))) (list -1 0))
                              ((and (< mr (- h 1)) (zero? (at g (+ mr 1) mcc))) (list 1 0))
                              ((and (> mcc 0) (zero? (at g mr (- mcc 1)))) (list 0 -1))
                              (else (list 0 1))))
                  (dr (* -1 (first open-dir)))
                  (dc (* -1 (second open-dir))))
             (reduce (lambda (grid i)
                       (let ((nr (+ mr (* dr i)))
                             (nc (+ mcc (* dc i))))
                         (if (and
                               (>= nr 0)
                               (< nr h)
                               (>= nc 0)
                               (< nc w)
                               (zero? (at grid nr nc)))
                             (set-cell grid nr nc minority)
                             grid)))
                     g
                     (range 1 (max h w)))))))
